entities.summary: Oleksandr Volodymyrovych Danylyuk is a Ukrainian public figure, lawyer, human rights activist. Coordinator of the public movement "Spilna Sprava". Chief Advisor to the Minister of Defense of Ukraine Valeriy Heletey on a voluntary basis from July 15 to November 5, 2014.
